The menu

The tavern’s printed menu, photographed in its Google listing, prices in euro including VAT. The grill is priced by the piece, so you put your own grill meze together; starters are dips, olives and a village salad. Guests on Google add the mixed grill platter, the draught beer and a glass of the house spirit to finish.

From the grill

Photos from the tavern’s own Google listing.

Wooden doors, checked tablecloths

Fakontis Tavern stands on Papakosta Leonidou street in Chlorakas, just north of Paphos: wooden doors, a blue sign reading Taverna Fakontis, checked tablecloths and the grill at the back. Its Facebook card says it in three words: on the grill. Lountza, halloumi, village sausage, sheftalia, pork and chicken kebab and lamb chops come off the charcoal by the piece, with dips and a village salad to start. On Google, the friendly staff is what guests mention most, followed by the grilled food, the kebab and the value for money.

Open Monday to Friday from five in the evening until eleven, Saturday until midnight, Sunday closed. Eat in or take away.
